objective: Prove, for a signed cubic triple system whose incidence graph is cellularly embedded in a closed surface of Euler characteristic chi: each face's agreement parity is fixed by the signs; signs making every face odd exist iff chi is even (F2 linear algebra on the faces), with 2^(dimension of H^1(S; F2)) classes up to gauge; and with such signs every assignment has violated lines minus the faces' excess agreements equal to chi/2, while for odd chi one face must be even. Then settle by SAT, for every sign class, the triangular-lattice knot spaces on tori (all sublattices of index up to about 60), Klein bottles and the projective plane (hexagons with antipodal gluing), with negative controls.
status: Proved 2026-11-07: on every closed surface violated lines minus the faces' excess agreements equal (chi - |D|)/2, so the count forces a violated line only on the sphere with Kasteleyn signs and over-agreeing faces when chi < |D|, orientation-blind and in PPADS^dt wherever it forces; satisfying assignments are perfect matchings in a prescribed homology class; lattice tori classified (unsatisfiable only degenerate, thin of even index, and the two Fano tori); Klein bottles, projective planes and genus-2 covers satisfiable in every tested class.
title: The knot's count on closed surfaces: parity, signs and satisfiability
